conclusions: P-only output re-reading produces a material development gain; current EEG latent information still adds beyond that strong output-only control.
Unsharing the same local latent support does not improve the selected solution: U32-S32 negative in all3 seeds, although other fixed lambdas have small positive deltas.
Full current latent C beats same-support local U32 for all3 lambdas and3 seeds. This includes increased parameter/function capacity and is not a raw EEG receptive-field or physiology claim.
Ccap beats C at their shared-selected lambdas in all3 seeds, but same-lambda .0001 is negative for all3. The gain depends on regularization and cannot isolate nonlinearity from expanded capacity.

Original P* is most overlap-consistent but least accurate. The exact fixed-Hann error identity shows disagreement can contribute ensemble reduction; neither smaller nor larger disagreement alone is a justified training target.
D6 contains no additional history input and does not reverse D4/D5 negative history findings.
limitations: Repeated source VAL development, known subjects and different clips with partial book-family overlap. No independent confirmation, significance, generalization or publication acceptance claim.
No pure Pearson-versus-MSE loss ablation: optimizer, parameterization and regularization differ from native P.
S32 sharing is in D4 coordinatewise TRAIN-normalized latent coordinates. S32/U32 share a dense whole-window P branch and native encoder sees full3s.
Nominal parameter matching is not effective-df/compute matching. Upstream encoder/head training and D4 moments are inherited nonzero costs.
Independent reconstruction uses cached frozen latents/P, not a fresh raw EEG/encoder replay, which was not needed for these algebraic-readout changes.
No new NN training, test/DTU inference, extra data or architecture expansion authorized by this result review itself.

disposition.acceptance: Bounded D6 attribution experiment completed; broader research success not established
disposition.parent: PASS; original results and public-only scope preserved
disposition.next: Preserve Ponly and strong C/Ccap as required controls; concrete next hypothesis and bounded matrix reviewed before fitting. Do not expand D4/D5/D6 or optimize overlap consistency merely because it is smaller.
